title: unified-rollouts: proactive canary + shadow autorollback enhancements
author: Priya Patel
body:
Context: We need more robust, proactive autorollback behaviour for mixed canary + shadow rollouts to reduce blast radius and improve safety when new model variants show regressions in production-like traffic. Motivation: incidents in Jan/Feb showed delayed rollback decisions for staged shadow probing where the metric signal arrives early in shadow traffic but action is gated to canary thresholds. This PR adds proactive detection logic that can trigger pre-emptive quarantines and automated rollback based on composite signals across canary, shadow, and probe stages.

Summary of changes: - Add proactive evaluator that aggregates metrics across canary, shadow, and probing stages and supports conditional quorum rules (e.g. require >=2 of 3 subsystems to cross thresholds). - Introduce a quarantine stage that can temporarily isolate a model variant without full rollback (supports manual review and automatic expiry). - Extend autorollback engine to accept prioritized signals (shadow-probe high-priority alerts can preempt lower-priority thresholds). - Add new telemetry (rollback_reason, quarantine_duration_ms, quorum_votes) and dashboard panels. - Add e2e + integration tests that simulate mixed traffic and flaky metric behaviour.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests for evaluator and quorum logic - [x] Integration tests for routing/quarantine paths - [x] e2e canary+shadow smoke scenario - [x] Updated rollout docs and console messages - [x] Performance benchmark to ensure evaluator is sub-ms per-eval

Commits summary: 4 commits (described below).

Changed areas (high level): services/rollouts (core rollout engine), runtime/autorollback (decision engine), infra/observability (metrics + dashboards), console (UI controls and notices), tests/e2e (smoke scenarios).

Testing and CI: Local unit + integration, CI passed full suite after two flake fixes. Load testing shows <0.5ms median evaluator latency on 99th percentile traffic for 5k concurrent rollouts.

Rollout plan: merged to main and released behind feature flag rollout.proactive_quorum. Gradual enablement: 0% -> 5% internal -> 25% beta customers -> 100% after 2 days monitoring. Feature flag includes per-tenant opt-out.

Notes for reviewers: focus review on quorum semantics and the quarantine lifecycle (automatic expiry and manual restore flows). The evaluator is intentionally conservative by default (requires 2/3 vote) and ship-configurable.

Merge: squash and merge to keep history focused.
commits: a1b2c3d: add proactive evaluator and quorum voting (core logic)
d4e5f6g: implement quarantine stage + lifecycle + APIs
h7i8j9k: add telemetry and dashboard panels; update observability mappings
l0m1n2o: e2e/integration tests for mixed canary+shadow scenarios; test fixtures
review_comments: Maya Singh (reviewer): Can you clarify how the quorum votes are weighted between canary and shadow? Looks like default is equal weight but we may want to prefer canary signals for user-visible regressions.
Priya Patel (author): Good point — updated evaluator to allow a weight config per-stage (defaults: canary=0.5, shadow=0.3, probe=0.2). See evaluator config in pkg/config/defaults/feature_flags.yaml.
Carlos Ortega (reviewer): Quarantine expiry needs to be observable. Please add metric for quarantine_duration and an event when a quarantine is auto-resolved.
Priya Patel (author): Added telemetry (quarantine_duration_ms and quarantine_auto_resolved event). Dashboard updated.
Elena Novak (reviewer): e2e test is flaky on CI (timing). Suggest making probe event timeouts configurable in test harness.
Priya Patel (author): Adjusted test harness to use deterministic clock mock and increased default timeouts in CI-only config. Reran CI and green.
Maya Singh (reviewer): Approving after addressing comments.
Carlos Ortega (reviewer): Approving. Left a minor nits on log message formatting which author fixed in the squash commit.
release_notes: Enhancements: Proactive quorum-based autorollback for mixed canary+shadow rollouts; quarantine stage to isolate unstable variants; new telemetry and dashboards for rollback reasons and quarantine durations; feature flag rollout.proactive_quorum (opt-out per-tenant).
notes: This PR addresses recent incidents where shadow-only signals were delayed in causing rollbacks. Production rollout gated behind feature flag; ops runbook updated to include quarantine investigation steps.
